lg.l: Spring this year in Austria started off benign,

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: the heavens lucid,the air stable,the about

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: sane to all feeders,vegetate and bestial:

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: the deathless minerals looked pleased iwth their regime,
where what is not forbidden is compulsory.

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: Shadows of course there are,Porn-Ads,with-it clergy,

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: and hubby next door has taken to the bottle,

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: but You have preserved your poise,strange rustic object,

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: whom I,made in God's Image but already warped,
a malapert will-worship,must bow to as Me.

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: My mortal manor,the carnal territory

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: allotted to my manage,also my fosterling

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: I must earn cash to support,my tutor also,

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: but for whose neural instructions I could never
acknowledge what is or imagine what is not.

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: Instinctively timid,I think,having neither

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: fangs nor talons nor hooves nor venom,and therefore

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: all too prone to let the sun go down on your fear,

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: a poor smeller or,rather,a censor of smells,
with a singular palate that enjoys hot food.

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: Unpredictably,decades ago,You arrived

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: among that unending cascade of creatures spewed

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: from Nature's maw. A random event,says Science.

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: Random,my bottom! a true miracle,say I,
for who is not certain that he was meant to be?

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: As You augmented,I looked at your looks askance:

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: Had I been free to pick Him,his architecture

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: would have been much more elegant. I've been let down!

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: By now,though,I've gotten used to your proportions,
and all things considered I might have fared far worse.

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: Seldom have You been a bother. For many years

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: You were,I admit, a martyr to horn-colic

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: (It did no good to tell You: But I'm not in love!),

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: how stoutly,though,You've repelled all germ invasions,
but never chastised my trantrums with a megrim.

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: You are the Injured Party for,if short-sighted,

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: I am the book-worm who tired You,if short-winded

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: as cigarette addicts are,I was the pusher

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: who got You hooked. (Had we been both a bit younger,
I might well have mischiefed You worse with a needle.)

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: I'm always amazed at how little I know You.

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: Your coasts and outgates I know,for I govern thenere there,

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: but what goes on inland,the rites,the social codes,

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: your torrents,salt and sunless,remain enigmas:
what I believe is on doctor's hearsay only.

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: our married life is a drama,but no stage-play where

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: what is not spoken is not thought: in our theatre

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: all that I cannot syllable You will pronounce

space.extent: undefined quantity of characters plus minimum

lg.l: in acts whose raison-d'etre escapes me. Why secrete
fluid when I dole or stretch your lips when I joy?
